texts.orig: The performance of a quantum computation system is investigated, with qubits represented by magnetic impurities in coupled quantum dots filled  with two electrons_ Magnetic impurities are electrically manipulated by electronsThe dominant noise source is the electron mediated indirect coupling between magnetic impurities and host spin bath. As a result of the electron mediated coupling; both noise properties   and the time needed for   elementary operations;   depend on controllable system parameters; such as size and geometry of the quantum dot, and external electric and magnetic fields. We find that the maximum number  of quantum operations per coherence time for magnetic impurities increases as electron gap decreases. The advantage of magnetic impurities over electrons for weak coupling and large magnetic fields will be illustrated_ gate spin

texts.orig: Another seminal idea of realizing quantum computation in semiconductors is by the use of hybrid qubit, first   proposed by Kane in 31P doped silicon host [2, 7, 8]- In silicon;, 31P is a positive dopant that is transformed into positively charged nucleus and loosely bound   valence  electron. Whereas ; the qubit is represented by the nuclear spin of 31P, electric operations on the electron are used   for manipulation and diagnostics of the qubit. The technological implementation of this system is more challenging; mostly as a result of the significantly smaller dimensions of the qubits. gate

texts.orig: Our configuration has two advantages over the original qubit systems.  First, it allows greater design flexibility; in particular with regard to the size of the confining potential. This will facilitate the actual technological realization of a hybrid qubit. Second, MI-electron coupling and electron mediated MI-spin bath coupling show particular dependence on the electron spin singlet triplet energy gap Ae, that allows forming stable over a range of QD confining potentials; and the external electric and magnetic fields. This system corresponds to the electron spin coded qubit system investigated in Ref.  [4] and makes a comparison possible.
